sections.description:
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, the power of Hydro will continually accumulate on the arrow. After fully charging, Sigewinne will periodically fire slow-moving Mini-Stration Bubbles toward the target, dealing Hydro DMG. When released, an arrow imbued with torrential energy will deal Hydro DMG to the opponent hit.

icdGate authored 2026-08-17 (ICD-group round b), CORRECTING this note's original claim that ICDGroupSigewinne was standard: its table entry (pkg/core/attacks/icd_groups.dm.go) is a 120f reset window in which only the FIRST hit applies. Measured 3/5 applied, which standard also gives at this 107f interval — which is how the group came to be recorded as standard when only its EFFECT on one fixture was observable. ⚠️ The lesson is the round's: an applied count says THAT the default is wrong, never what is right.

Tick COUNT is bubbleHitLimit (sigewinne.go: 5 base, +3 at C1 → 8) and is already expressed by the summon's duration 7.1s plus the C1 durationModifier +5.4s; the CADENCE is unchanged at C1, so no constellation-gated second series is authored. tickCap 5 / 8 at C1 (tick-cap round, 2026-08-18): gcsim sigewinne.go sets `c.bubbleHitLimit = 5` and `if c.Base.Cons >= 1 { c.bubbleHitLimit += 3 }` - an explicit COUNT, which is what the geometry note above was already expressing indirectly through the C1 durationModifier. abilities.description:
Blows a Bolstering Bubblebalm that can stimulate blood flow and help patients drift off to sleep using a bubblegun specially made in the Fortress of Meropide.
Bolstering Bubblebalms will bounce between nearby opponents, dealing Hydro DMG based on Sigewinne's max HP to opponents it hits. When it bounces, it will restore HP to all nearby party members except Sigewinne herself. The amount healed is based on Sigewinne's max HP.
After bouncing 5 times, the Bolstering Bubblebalm will disappear and restore HP to Sigewinne based on her max HP value.
When no opponents are present, the Bolstering Bubblebalm will bounce nearby. Only one Bolstering Bubblebalm created by a Sigewinne may exist at once.
When Held, the Bolstering Bubblebalm can be boosted to an even bigger size.

Hold
Enter Aiming Mode to begin blowing an even bigger, even more breathtaking Bolstering Bubblebalm!
The Bolstering Bubblebalm will grow bigger the longer the skill is Held, until it grows up to two tiers in size. Each tier it grows increases its DMG by 5% and healing by 5%. When a Bolstering Bubblebalm bounces, it will drop down a tier in size, until it returns to being a normal Bolstering Bubblebalm.
After weaker opponents are hit by big Bolstering Bubblebalms, they will be imprisoned and will be unable to move.

In addition, 2 Sourcewater Droplets will be created near Sigewinne when she uses this Skill. Each Sourcewater Droplet Sigewinne collects will grant her a Bond of Life worth 10% of her Max HP.
When Sigewinne's Bond of Life is cleared, she regains 1 Elemental Energy for every 2,000 HP worth of the Bond of Life that was cleared. Sigewinne can regain up to 5 Elemental Energy in this way.

Arkhe: Ousia
Bolstering Bubblebalms periodically call down a Surging Blade on the position they hit, dealing Ousia-aligned Hydro DMG based on Sigewinne's max HP.

Shield persists for skill/burst animation duration (addC2Shield on cast, removeC2Shield on OnRemoved); the 250% Hydro absorption efficiency is not modelled. Authored as two effects since onHit doesn't accept array of abilityTypes. Each fires independently — same hydro RES debuff renders per trigger site.

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C2 "Can the Most Merciful of Spirits Defeat Its Foes?" — effects[0] (shield hp 30, self) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `~/Code/gcsim/internal/characters/sigewinne/shield.go:13-32` — `addC2Shield()` creates a 0.3 × MaxHP Hydro shield; it is called from `skill.go:100` and `burst.go:72`, and torn down by `removeC2Shield()` (`shield.go:34-41`) from each cast's `OnRemoved` (`skill.go:106-109`, `burst.go:81-89`). gcsim's `Expires` is `F + 15*60` but is never reached — the animation-state removal always cuts it first. Retain — `addC2Shield` fires from both `skill.go:100` and `burst.go:72` and dies in each cast's `OnRemoved`, so the duration IS the cast animation (⛔ never gcsim's unreachable `15*60` expiry); the 250% Hydro absorption efficiency stays unmodelled; `label` is the kit's own "Bubbly Shield" (gcsim names it "Bubbly Shield (C2)" — ⛔ don't carry the constellation suffix into the lane). ⚠️ ⚠️⚠️ The two durations MIRROR `frames.anim` and nothing keeps them in sync — a frames-audit migration on either ability silently makes the bar wrong. ⚠️ They are also single numbers for abilities with variants: the skill's `Short Hold` (56f = 0.93s) and `Hold` (89f = 1.48s) and the burst's `C4` variant (429f = 7.15s) all hold the shield longer, so the bar under-claims there — an omission, not a divergence, but a C4 owner loses 3s of it. ⚠️ Precedence is safe: `registerShieldOnCast` case 2 (explicit `shield` Effect with a duration) wins over case 1, and the skill's `tags` are `["heal"]` not `["shield"]`, so the Bolstering Bubblebalm summon cannot be mistaken for the shield's lifetime. If the curator will not accept a frames-mirrored number in data, the fallback is RETIRE — the trigger is exact, only the length is unstatable.

_curatorNotes: Stub-with-caveat + consolidation (decided 2026-05-14, onHeal category): consolidated 4 generator-artifact effects → 2 scaling-with-cap buffs using v0.4 (ca5c643) cap rendering. Formula (cons.go): +0.4% CR per 1000 MaxHP (ratio 0.0004 in percentage-per-HP form), cap +20% CR; +2.2% CD per 1000 MaxHP (ratio 0.0022), cap +110% CD. Duration 15s per proc. gcsim source: c6CritMode() called from bubbleHealing() and bubbleFinalHealing() (Bubblebalm bounces). onHeal primitive intentionally not built — Sigewinne C6 is the only practical consumer; the other 4 candidates require overheal/HP-state simulation that's out of scope. Re-evaluate only if those primitives ever land.

[A7] C6 is the corpus's only practical onHeal consumer; the other candidates (Gaming C2, Wriothesley A4/C2, Charlotte C1) need overheal/HP-state primitives that are out of scope. (This rationale is already recorded in the effect's _curatorNotes.)

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — A blank where a self buff bar belongs. Both effects are `trigger: 'manual'`, which reaches no bar, no chip and no toggle (rubric N1), so a C6 owner reading her rows sees the bubble lane ticking heals and NO CRIT bar on her received-buff row — while every other character's CRIT buffs in the same team draw as bars. The absence is the misleading thing, and the caveat is constellation-gated so it reaches only the readers who own it. Category: expected-but-absent.

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C6 "Can the Most Radiant of Spirits Pray For Me?" — effects[0] (buff critRate, scaling hp 0.0004 cap 20) and effects[1] (buff critDmg, scaling hp 0.0022 cap 110) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `~/Code/gcsim/internal/characters/sigewinne/cons.go:41-58` — `c6CritMode()` adds CR `min(0.2, MaxHP*0.004/1000)` and CD `min(1.1, MaxHP*0.022/1000)` for `15*60` frames, gated to `AttackTagElementalBurst`. It is called from exactly two sites, both inside the skill's Bubblebalm bounce: `skill.go:216` (`bubbleHealing`, per healed teammate) and `skill.go:233` (`bubbleFinalHealing`). ⚓ `Heal(` appears at only `skill.go:209` and `skill.go:226` in the whole package — the burst never heals — so "when Sigewinne performs healing" is exactly "on a Bolstering Bubblebalm bounce", and a bounce is one task that both heals and hits (`skill.go:117-136`). constellations.description: When Sigewinne performs healing, she will increase the CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG of her Super Saturated Syringing based on her Max HP. Every 1,000 Max HP she has will increase CRIT Rate by 0.4% and CRIT DMG by 2.2% for 15s. The maximum increase achievable this way is 20% CRIT Rate and 110% CRIT DMG.
constellations.caveat: The CRIT bars cover all of Sigewinne's damage; in game the bonus only reaches Super Saturated Syringing.
